storeroom_dead.name: The Flooded Stores
storeroom_dead.intro: (EXAMPLE ENCOUNTER) The drowned stores heave. A bloated shape rises from the floodwater, water pouring from its mouth - and behind it a living scavenger straightens, soaked to the chest, a stolen strongbox under one arm and a longsword in the other hand. He came down here to rob the dead, and he is not inclined to share.

victory_effects.text: The drowned thing collapses into the flood, and the looter goes down with it. The storeroom is quiet, except for the drip of water and your own breathing.

crypt_warden.name: The Gate-Warden's Crypt
crypt_warden.intro: (EXAMPLE ENCOUNTER) Corvin's courtesy ends. He comes over the bier with his mouth open, and something answers him from the dark.

victory_effects.text: The Gate-Warden comes apart like wet parchment. The crypt is still. Whatever held the bell's memory here has let go.

town_square_zombies.name: Zombies in Town Square (E3, adapted)
town_square_zombies.intro: (SOURCE-ADAPTED ENCOUNTER) The eastern barricade gives way. Ashlyn is hard-pressed at the center of the square as infected dead push through the gap.

victory_effects.text: The last infected zombie falls. The square is quiet. Ashlyn lowers her sword and looks toward the church.

qa_turn_undead.name: QA: Turning the Dead (not campaign content)
qa_turn_undead.intro: (QA SCENARIO — isolated from campaign content) A ghoul and a drowned dead lurch forward. Behind them, an infected zombie keeps coming: six Hit Dice, beyond a 3rd-level cleric's turning check unless the roll is exceptional.

qa_victory.name: QA: Reward Smoke (not campaign content)
qa_victory.intro: (QA SCENARIO — isolated from campaign content) A single drowned dead blocks the way; the party begins adjacent so victory can be observed in a few actions.
